'''Sander Hartlage''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Atlanta DPC]] on 28 July 2001 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT Merc Pilots]], according to Geoff Gallo-Cornell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2755">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-loaf-goes-to-dpc-atlantad2755/ loaf-goes-to-dpc-atlanta], DeckTech (Geoff "Loaf" Gallo-Cornell, 31 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-loaf-goes-to-dpc-atlantad2755/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
